title: Nonvanishing of the shifted polynomial
statement: Let $\ell,n\in\mathbb{N}$ and let $\gamma\in\{0,1\}^n$ be nonzero. Then the polynomial $\sum_{i=0}^{n-1}\gamma_i X^i$, with coefficients viewed in the field with $2^\ell$ elements, is nonzero.
hypotheses_covered: A nonzero binary vector $\gamma$ of length $n$
